scenario.name: Campus morning peak replay
scenario.description: A full-campus replay of the highest measured morning in the dataset. All 22 monitored facilities are included, with Central Kitchens highlighted as the largest controllable contributor.
scenario.demonstration_goal: Show the forecast identifying the next peak before a current-demand rule and prepare an operator-approved response without touching protected services.
scenario.planning_limit_basis: 94% of the observed replay peak, used as a configurable operational reserve threshold

metrics.claim_boundary: Scenario cost and demand-charge values are software-in-the-loop planning proxies. They are not realised savings or a reproduced institutional invoice.

comparison.interpretation: The forecast-assisted controller can schedule an approved action one interval before the current-demand rule. Results depend on the disclosed scenario response model and are planning evidence, not field savings.

method.baseline: Measured full-campus half-hourly replay across 22 monitored facilities.
method.controller_isolation: All controllers receive the same baseline. Only decision timing and action policy differ.
method.response_model: Load-group partitions, action delay, protected floors and recovery are disclosed software-in-the-loop assumptions.
method.claim_boundary: Results are repeatable planning evidence, not commissioned field savings.
